purpose: Assess whether existing development data can support one causal, capped variance-budget hypothesis before any financial implementation.

literature.title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
literature.paraphrase: The paper scales monthly factor returns using prior-month realized variance. Its factor evidence does not establish an intraday CFD result.
literature.adaptation: Daily 1m reference-window variance, a trailing median normalization and a cap-only budget are our proposed adaptation, not the published implementation.

proposed_hypothesis: Reducing only planned new-entry risk after unusually volatile completed sessions may reduce adverse portfolio exposure. Natural-stop sizing already reduces quantity as stop width grows, so this can double-reduce exposure and worsen minimum-lot capture.

proposed_rules.reference_window: 09:30-16:00 America/New_York,390 complete minute bars under the existing inferred clock; not independently verified venue hours
proposed_rules.variance: Squared log close-to-close returns; first minute uses its open. No overnight return. Reject incomplete, duplicated or invalid windows.
proposed_rules.lag: Immediately preceding weekday must be complete; missing holidays or early closes remain unavailable rather than inferred.
proposed_rules.normalization: Median of60 complete reference-window variances strictly before the lag session
proposed_rules.planned_budget: A possible future experimental wrapper may only reduce min(0.5% current equity,25USD), original recovery controls and remaining gross portfolio headroom. No leverage or risk increase.
proposed_rules.entries_and_exits: Preserve original SPX15 1.5R60minutes and NAS15 2R90minutes capped16NY, including natural initial stops, signal rules, legal lots and cost assumptions.
proposed_rules.fallback: No imputation or reduced warmup; no alternate lookback or threshold selected from this audit.

feasibility_gate: At least20 development weekdays with a causal feature for EACH instrument; this is data feasibility, not financial sample sufficiency.

duplicate_review.conclusion: Prior fixed/loss/drawdown risk cuts, ATR entry gates, holding changes and break-even exits are related but do not use this lagged realized-variance budget. A negative text search alone was not treated as semantic proof.

limitations: All prices are previously exposed; no independent validation.
Historical server/DST, commissions, margin, liquidity and reference-window coverage remain uncertain.
Feature availability is not an eligible trade, missed winner, return forecast or target pass.
No candidate selection, financial replay, paper-book change or new collection occurs in this audit.
atlas_observation: Stopped by explicit user decision; this audit does not initialize a terminal.
